title: What is tasawwuf?
summary: Tasawwuf as Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. explains it while reading Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara: an inner knowledge whose source is the Qur'an and the Hadith, for the reform of both body and soul.

blocks.p: When Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. began the dars of the book Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, he explained what this knowledge is and what it is for. This article gathers what he says, in his own words where we can.
Hazrat calls it ilm-e-tasawwuf, or ilm-e-ladunni: a knowledge of the deen that is not seen from outside, but is found inwardly. He says more than once that it does not come from anywhere new.

blocks.q: The source of Sufism, or the knowledge of ladunni, is the Hadith and the Qur'an.

blocks.note: This passage is taken from the machine transcript of the recording, which is rough in places. The wording should be checked against the Urdu recording before approval. (Part 1, 53:28 to 55:08.)

blocks.p: Reading from the book, Hazrat teaches that a human being is the union of the soul and the body, and that each is reformed in its own way: the body by Shariat and Tariqat, the soul by Haqiqat and Marifat.

blocks.q: Shariat is to pray, to fast, to perform Hajj, to pay Zakat. All of this is Shariat. And what is Tariqat? To build a connection with Allah and His Messenger ﷺ.

blocks.p: For the soul, he says, Haqiqat means the hidden, inner things: Allah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, the last Prophet, the angels, the whole order of creation. We have not seen them with our eyes; we come to know them through the Qur'an and the Ahadith.

blocks.q: The things of the soul cannot be seen; we come to know them through knowledge.

blocks.p: Why are there different ways, Qadri, Chishti, Naqshbandi and others? Hazrat answers: just as the jurists who draw from the Qur'an and Hadith differ (Hanafi, Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali), the Sufi ways are also ways of drawing from the Qur'an and Hadith. People's temperaments differ, and each looks for what suits him.

blocks.q: All the Sufi ways are good, good from head to toe. But along with that, in one the eyes are beautiful, in another the smile, in another the speech.

blocks.p: Hazrat explains the aim of the book this way: through this knowledge every person should live by the commands of Allah and of His Prophet ﷺ, choose the right path for guidance, take bai'at, repent, take up taqwa, and keep busy in worship.

blocks.note: This passage is taken from the machine transcript of the recording, which is rough in places. The wording should be checked against the Urdu recording before approval. (Part 1, 53:57.)

ru.title: Tasawwuf kya hai?
ru.summary: Tasawwuf, jaisa Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara padhte hue samjhaate hain: ek baatini ilm jiska sarchashma Qur'an aur Hadith hai, jism aur rooh dono ki islaah ke liye.

blocks.p: Jab Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. ne kitaab Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara ka dars shuru kiya, to unhone samjhaaya ke yeh ilm kya hai aur kis liye hai. Is mazmoon mein woh baatein jama ki gayi hain jo woh farmate hain, jahaan tak ho saka unke apne alfaaz mein.
Hazrat isko ilm-e-tasawwuf, ya ilm-e-ladunni kehte hain: deen ka woh ilm jo baahar se nazar nahin aata, balke andar paaya jaata hai. Woh kai baar farmate hain ke yeh kahin naye se nahin aaya.

blocks.q: Tasawwuf, ya ilm-e-ladunni, ka sarchashma Hadith aur Qur'an hai.

blocks.note: Yeh hissa recording ke machine transcript se liya gaya hai, jo kahin kahin kachcha hai. Manzoori se pehle alfaaz Urdu recording se mila lene chahiye. (Part 1, 53:28 se 55:08.)

blocks.p: Kitaab se padhte hue Hazrat sikhaate hain ke insaan rooh aur jism ka milaap hai, aur har ek ki islaah apne tareeqe se hoti hai: jism ki Shariat aur Tariqat se, rooh ki Haqiqat aur Marifat se.

blocks.q: Shariat yeh hai: namaz padhna, roza rakhna, Hajj karna, Zakat dena. Yeh sab Shariat hai. Aur Tariqat kya hai? Allah aur Uske Rasool ﷺ se ta'alluq banaana.

blocks.p: Rooh ke liye, woh farmate hain, Haqiqat yaani chhupi hui, andar ki cheezein: Allah, Rasoolullah ﷺ, aakhri Nabi, farishte, saari kaayenaat ka nizaam. Humne inko aankhon se nahin dekha; hum inko Qur'an aur Ahadith ke zariye jaante hain.

blocks.q: Rooh ki cheezein dikhaayi nahin deti; hum inko ilm ke zariye jaante hain.

blocks.p: Alag alag tareeqe kyun hain, Qadri, Chishti, Naqshbandi aur doosre? Hazrat jawaab dete hain: jaise Qur'an aur Hadith se lene wale fuqaha mein ikhtilaaf hai (Hanafi, Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali), waise hi Sufiya ke tareeqe bhi Qur'an aur Hadith se lene ke tareeqe hain. Logon ke mizaaj alag hote hain, aur har ek woh dhoondta hai jo uske mizaaj ke mutaabiq ho.

blocks.q: Sufiya ke saare tareeqe achhe hain, sar se paaon tak achhe. Lekin iske saath, kisi mein aankhein khoobsurat hain, kisi mein muskuraahat, kisi mein baat-cheet.

blocks.h: Yeh aap se kya chahta hai

blocks.p: Hazrat kitaab ka maqsad is tarah samjhaate hain: is ilm ke zariye har aadmi Allah aur Uske Nabi ﷺ ke ahkaam par chale, hidaayat ke liye sahi raasta chune, bai'at kare, tauba kare, taqwa ikhtiyaar kare, aur ibaadat mein mashghool rahe.

blocks.note: Yeh hissa recording ke machine transcript se liya gaya hai, jo kahin kahin kachcha hai. Manzoori se pehle alfaaz Urdu recording se mila lene chahiye. (Part 1, 53:57.)
